qa.verdict: REVISED spec resolves BOTH round-1 blocking defects and the codex round-2 expansion is verified correct and complete. (QA-F1 resolved) The skip-emit guard is now SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS=new Set(['breakfast','lunch','dinner']) routed through buildSkipMuts; this exactly matches the only 3 valid persisted meal slot keys per day.schema.json (slots additionalProperties:false), so meals-any/activity/accommodation can never reach a skip mutation -> no schema-invalid disk write. (QA-F2 resolved) AC2b mandates symmetric source+target skip(false) coverage, de-duplicated, applied to all six board-drop handlers' board branch plus Site B origin. (6-handler expansion verified) Exactly six board-drop handlers exist at react_template.tpl:917/994/1072/1150/1307/1915, all sharing the identical board/candidates/else triad emitting select-only today; 917 (Kanban meals, slot=opt._type) and 1915 (Timeline) are real meal paths correctly covered; 994(cafe-to-activity)/1072(activity)/1150(entertainment-to-activity)/1307(accommodation, hardcoded data-slot-id) are genuine no-ops because their slot ids are never breakfast/lunch/dinner so buildSkipMuts returns [] (double-protected: _isCompatible also rejects meal drags before save). Payload shape {type:'skip',slot:<id>,extra:{skipped:false,skipped_reason:null}} matches _apply_skip_mutation (save.py:107-114) exactly. No ordering/dedup hazard (independent fields, sequential apply, Set-based dedup). Approved for dev.

validation_checks.check: 1. QA-F1 resolved — SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS guard for ALL backend skip emits; meals-any can never reach a skip mutation
validation_checks.evidence: Revised spec lines 59,112,217-218 introduce const SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS = new Set(['breakfast','lunch','dinner']) and mandate ALL skip emits route through buildSkipMuts = (...ids)=>[...new Set(ids)].filter(s=>s && SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS.has(s)).map(...). Verified against schemas/v2/day.schema.json:53-66 — slots properties are exactly {breakfast, morning_activity, lunch, afternoon_activity, dinner, evening_activity} with required[] + additionalProperties:false; valid MEAL slots = breakfast/lunch/dinner; morning_activity/afternoon_activity/evening_activity are NOT meals; accommodation is a separate top-level key. SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS={breakfast,lunch,dinner} matches the 3 valid persisted meal keys EXACTLY and excludes meals-any. Confirmed save.py:65 _get_or_create_slot setdefaults ANY slot_id unvalidated, so the front-end SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS filter is the only guard — it is correctly load-bearing. AC7 enforces no schema-invalid slot key (static: every type:'skip' emit produced only via buildSkipMuts; live: no slots['meals-any'] key after non-meal drops). Existing MEAL_SLOTS (still includes meals-any at react_template.tpl:2227) is correctly retained for UI/React-state only, NOT for backend skip emits. codex round-2 independently confirmed buildSkipMuts excludes meals-any.

validation_checks.check: 2. QA-F2 resolved — AC2b mandates source-side skip(false); symmetric source+target deduped emits at Sites A/B/C
validation_checks.evidence: Revised spec AC2b (lines 179-184) mandates: a board move emitting select(sourceSlotId,null)+select(toSlotId,opt) at ANY of the six board-drop handlers, OR an applyBridge move emptying an originSlotId (Site B), must enqueue skip(false) for the source/origin slot in addition to the target — neither side re-gates on reload, de-duplicated when source==target. Technical Hints lines 224,226 prescribe buildSkipMuts(payload.sourceSlotId, toSlotId) for the board branch (BOTH sides) and buildSkipMuts(targetSlotId, originSlotId-if-distinct) for Site B. Verified Site C board branch at react_template.tpl:917/1915 currently emits select(sourceSlotId,null)+select(toSlotId,opt) — the prepend covers both. Verified Site B at react_template.tpl:2968-2989 empties originSlotId on move, so un-gating origin is correct. AC2 covers Site B target+origin. AC2c covers Site C target+fallback+else branches across all 6. codex confirmed completeness.

validation_checks.check: 3. 6-handler verification — exactly 6 handlers, meal vs non-meal classification
validation_checks.evidence: Grep direction === 'board' in react_template.tpl returns exactly 917, 994, 1072, 1150, 1307, 1915 (plus 2350 deselect predicate = Site A). All six Read and confirmed to share the identical board/candidates/else onDrop triad emitting select-only (zero type:'skip' emits exist today). Classification verified by Read of each handler's slot-id source: 917 uses opt._type from the ['breakfast','lunch','dinner'].flatMap meals row (line 843) => REAL meal path, correctly covered. 1915 timelineSlotId => REAL meal path (codex confirmed timeline meal resolution checks only breakfast/lunch/dinner at 1736-1762; never resolves to meals-any), correctly covered. 994 cafeSlotId maps to ['morning_activity','afternoon_activity','evening_activity'] (line 933) => non-meal. 1072 actSlotId (attractions/activity) => non-meal. 1150 entSlotId (entertainment-to-activity) => non-meal. 1307 hardcoded data-slot-id=accommodation (line 1304) => non-meal. The filter cannot accidentally emit for activity/cafe/entertainment/accommodation slot ids because none of them are breakfast/lunch/dinner.

validation_checks.check: 4. buildSkipMuts correctness — dedups, SKIPPABLE filter, exact payload shape, no drift
validation_checks.evidence: Helper (spec lines 131,218): (...ids)=>[...new Set(ids)].filter(s=>s && SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS.has(s)).map(s=>({type:'skip',slot:s,extra:{skipped:false,skipped_reason:null}})). [...new Set(ids)] dedups self-drops/repeats. .filter(s=>s && SKIPPABLE_MEAL_SLOTS.has(s)) drops falsy + non-{breakfast,lunch,dinner}. Output {type:'skip', slot:<id>, extra:{skipped:false, skipped_reason:null}} matches _apply_skip_mutation (save.py:108-114): slot_id=mut.get('slot') (top-level field 'slot', NOT slot_id — trap noted in spec line 157,232); extra=mut.get('extra'); slot['skipped']=bool(extra.get('skipped',True)) (false passed explicitly un-gates); slot['skipped_reason']=extra.get('skipped_reason') (null valid when skipped=false). No extra/renamed fields, no drift. codex confirmed schema/server-conformant.
